newsitem.title: USA: Echo-Netmaster says proposes merger with Affinity.
newsitem.headline: Echo-Netmaster says proposes merger with Affinity.

text.p: Echo-Netmaster Acquisition Corp, a privately held company, said Tuesday it sent a formal proposal to a subsidiary of Affinity Entertainment Inc to merge its Internet service-based assets with the company.
Echo-Net said its investment group had also offered to provide up to $5.0 million in equity financing to Affinity thruough the purchase of its restricted common shares and preferred shares.
EchoNet said it would like to complete the transaction immediately.
Echo-Net said its first year sales are projected at $3.0 million.
